rules.number: minimum shot 4 s; aim for one take per 10-15 s
rules.cite: board 43001699: 0 cuts in 9.75 s, one handheld shot

rules.rule: Let the camera and subject move; never add digital zoom or push.
Keep text off the picture unless it carries information.
rules.number: at most one text element on screen at a time; captions only when someone speaks

rules.rule: Text arrives slowly and leaves quickly.
rules.number: entrances 500-700 ms ease-out; exits 300 ms; holds >= 2.5 s
rules.cite: judgment (the board reel has no text or cuts to time against; DECISIONS 54)

rules.rule: Join shots with a cut or a short dissolve; no wipes that slide, spin or zoom.
rules.cite: board has no transitions; judgment (the board reel has no text or cuts to time against; DECISIONS 54)

rules.rule: Graphics use the still kit unchanged: glass panel, pill chip, caption role, hairline.
